description: AbstractProtocolValidator is an abstract Java class defining protocol-specific validation logic for Connection objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for validating URI schemes, source and target configurations, payload mappings, header mappings, and placeholder usage, tailored to connection protocols and configurations.

classes.name: AbstractProtocolValidator
classes.description: Defines abstract and concrete methods for protocol-specific validation of Connectivity Connection objects in Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Abstract method to return the specific connection type this validator applies to.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Abstract method to validate a connection of the specified type, throwing exceptions if errors are found.

methods.name: validateUriScheme
methods.description: Checks if the connection's URI scheme is within accepted schemes and whether the security configuration is appropriate.

methods.name: validateSourceConfigs
methods.description: Validates the configuration of sources in the connection.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Abstract method to validate individual source configurations, including placeholder usage.

methods.name: validateTargetConfigs
methods.description: Validates target configurations in the connection.

methods.name: validatePayloadMappings
methods.description: Validates payload mappings for sources and targets within the connection.

methods.name: validateHeaderMapping
methods.description: Validates that header mappings are correctly configured with valid placeholders.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Abstract method to validate individual target configurations, including placeholder usage.

methods.name: sourceDescription
methods.description: Creates a descriptive string for a source for validation error messages.

methods.name: targetDescription
methods.description: Creates a descriptive string for a target for validation error messages.

methods.name: validateTemplate
methods.description: Validates that a template string's placeholders are correctly used and resolvable.

methods.name: validateTemplateAndReplace
methods.description: Validates and replaces placeholders in a template string with a dummy value, ensuring complete placeholder resolution.
